ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rectangle $ABCD$, where $AB=4$ and $AD=2$, $E$ is the midpoint of $AB$, $F$ is a moving point on $EC$, and $P$ is the midpoint of $DF$. Connect $PB$. What is the minimum value of $PB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure:

When point $F$ coincides with point $C$, point $P$ is at ${P}_{1}$, and $C{P}_{1}=D{P}_{1}$,

When point $F$ coincides with point $E$, point $P$ is at ${P}_{2}$, and $E{P}_{2}=D{P}_{2}$,

$\therefore {P}_{1}{P}_{2}\parallel CE$ and ${P}_{1}{P}_{2}=\frac{1}{2}CE$.

When point $F$ is on segment $EC$ except at points $C$ and $E$, $DP=FP$.

According to the Midline Theorem: ${P}_{1}P\parallel CE$ and ${P}_{1}P=\frac{1}{2}CF$.

$\therefore$ The trajectory of point $P$ is the line segment ${P}_{1}{P}_{2}$,

$\therefore$ When $BP\perp {P}_{1}{P}_{2}$, $PB$ reaches its minimum value.

$\because$ In rectangle $ABCD$, $AB=4$, $AD=2$, $E$ is the midpoint of $AB$,

$\therefore \triangle CBE$, $\triangle ADE$, $\triangle BC{P}_{1}$ are isosceles right triangles, and $C{P}_{1}=2$.

$\therefore \angle ADE=\angle CDE=\angle C{P}_{1}B=45^\circ$, $\angle DEC=90^\circ$.

$\therefore \angle D{P}_{2}{P}_{1}=90^\circ$.

$\therefore \angle D{P}_{1}{P}_{2}=45^\circ$.

$\therefore \angle {P}_{2}{P}_{1}B=90^\circ$, i.e., $B{P}_{1}\perp {P}_{1}{P}_{2}$,

$\therefore$ The minimum value of $BP$ is the length of $B{P}_{1}$.

In the isosceles right triangle $BC{P}_{1}$, $C{P}_{1}=BC=2$,

$\therefore B{P}_{1}=2\sqrt{2}$

$\therefore$ The minimum value of $PB$ is $\boxed{2\sqrt{2}}$.
